Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Line ke neeche wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona neeche pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
